strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.В вымышленном разделе «Бюджет {{caseYear: The fictional “Budget {{caseYear}}” section contains the adopted decision and appendices 1 and 2. The number, date, version and contents match the request and archive inventory. An external-connection check confirms that all three files are accessible without an internal login.
strings.В отличие от истории с одним проектом бю: Unlike the case where only a draft budget was available, here the exact documents requested and access to the appendices have been confirmed.
strings.В учебном деле гражданин запросил текст: In this training case, a citizen requested the adopted decision and two appendices electronically, without requesting a certified copy. All three documents are available on the official website. Before replying, you check that the version matches, the set is complete and access works. No breach is attributed to any real authority.
It is important to compare the identifying details and version.
strings.Выберите допустимые действия и проверьте: Choose permitted actions and check their order. Independent actions may be carried out in different sequences.
strings.Главная страница или конкретный документ: The home page or a specific document?
strings.Главная страница любого официального сай: The home page of any official website is sufficient for any request.
strings.Да. Старую ссылку нашёл в сообщении сосе: Yes. I found the old link in my neighbour's message, but I do not know where to look after the section was updated.
strings.Даже при согласованной электронной форме: Even when electronic access is agreed, the law always requires certified scans to be produced.
strings.Для уже опубликованной информации допуст: For information already published, a reply may identify the publication or the official website address where it appears. Verify that the requested information is actually on that official website. A direct link is more convenient, but is not itself the only format permitted by law.
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Есть ли доступ к сайту с вашего устройст: Can you access the website from your device?
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия работника М: A complaint about a service centre employee's decisions and actions goes to that centre's director. Do not confuse a centre employee with the body providing the service.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия самого МФЦ: A complaint about the service centre's own decisions and actions goes to its founding authority or an official authorised by a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Закон вообще запрещает отвечать ссылкой: The law entirely prohibits responding with a link to published information.
strings.Запрос зарегистрирован, относится к деят: The request is registered and concerns the recipient's activities; no deferral has been applied. Determine the final day for replying. Prior publication does not in itself create a new receipt date.
strings.Запрос информации рассматривается по спе: An information request follows special rules. If the information does not concern the recipient's activities, apply referral to the competent body with notification to the user.
strings.Запрошенные документы действительно опуб: The requested documents really are published and accessible; the response may indicate where they are published.
strings.Зафиксировать, какие материалы и каким с: Record which materials are available to the applicant and by which method
strings.Здесь принятый документ и все запрошенны: Here, the adopted document and every requested appendix really are published and accessible. This permits a different response from a link to a draft or an inaccessible file.
strings.Какие документы и в какой форме вы запро: Which documents did you request, and in what format?
strings.Какое решение вы ищете: проект или приня: Which decision are you looking for: a draft or an adopted one?
strings.Какой вывод следует из сверки?: What conclusion follows from the cross-check?
strings.Любая ссылка означает, что документов у: Any link means the authority does not hold the documents.
strings.Любой официальный сайт освобождает орган: Any official website releases the body from checking the response's content.
strings.Мне нужны решение о бюджете на {{caseYea: I need the decision on the {{caseYear}} budget and its appendices. My neighbour says officials must always send certified scans and cannot reply with a link. So far, I have submitted an ordinary request through the electronic form.
strings.Найдите норму и проверьте её применимост: Find the provision and check applicability. A click count cannot replace information from external sources.
strings.Найдите правило ответа ссылкой на уже оп: Find the rule for responding with a reference to information already published.
strings.Направить запрос в министерство, на сайт: Forward the request to the ministry whose website contains the text of 8-ФЗ.
strings.Начните с предмета обращения. Уточните,: Start with the appeal's subject. Clarify who made the disputed decision and which information is confirmed.
strings.Не отвечать, поскольку информацию уже оп: Do not reply because the information has already been published.
strings.Номер части статьи 19 закона 8-ФЗ: Number of the part of Article 19 of Law 8-FZ
strings.Нужен доступный путь к нужным документам: An accessible route to the required documents is needed; electronic access is not prohibited.
strings.Обновить путь к публикации либо приложит: Update the publication path or attach the documents; recheck access and completeness before sending.
strings.Орган определяет подразделение или должн: The body designates the unit or officials responsible for information access. Publishing a law on a ministry website does not mean that ministry holds every requested local document.
strings.Оставить запрос без ответа, поскольку до: Leave the request unanswered because the documents are already online
strings.Ответ ссылкой полностью запрещён даже дл: Responding with a link is entirely prohibited, even for published documents.
strings.Ответ указанием места публикации допусти: A response identifying the publication location is permissible when the specific requested information is published there.
strings.Отделите реквизиты документа от его прим: Separate a document's particulars from its application. In the working source check, attach a specific passage and extract information from it.
strings.Отправить старую ссылку: она работала пр: Send the old link: it worked when first checked.
strings.Подготовить ответ с указанием, где разме: Prepare a response indicating where the exact information requested is published, or provide it by another permissible method.
strings.Подготовить ответ у обладателя информаци: Have the information holder prepare a response indicating the official publication, or provide the electronic documents.
strings.Подготовить полный ответ: место официаль: Prepare a complete response: the official publication location or electronic documents
strings.Поиск принятых муниципальных документов: Begin searching for adopted municipal documents with Council of Deputies decisions and the budget section. A page labelled 'Draft' does not confirm that a decision was adopted.
strings.Помощник: «После публикации документов м: Assistant: “Once the documents are published, we can simply close the incoming request without replying.”
strings.После подготовки ответа раздел сайта пер: After the response was prepared, the website section was moved. The old link now leads to an error page, while the documents remain in the new section. The response has not yet been sent.
strings.После принятия решения заявителю направл: After the decision, a reasoned reply must be sent to the applicant no later than the following day. This is a separate action, not a new full complaint consideration period.
strings.Потребовать объяснить цель получения общ: Require an explanation of the purpose for obtaining the publicly accessible budget
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
The subject and format of the request are established.
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.Признать любое использование ссылки неза: Declare any use of a link unlawful.
strings.Принятое решение в редакции, указанной в: The adopted decision in the version specified in the request, not discussion materials.
strings.Проверить доступность выбранного способа: Check that the chosen method of access is available
strings.Проверить предмет запроса и указанную фо: Check the subject of the request and the specified format
strings.Проверьте исходное событие и единицы счё: Check the triggering event and counting units. The reply deadline may differ from the deadline for a specific action.
strings.Проверьте основание ответа ссылкой на уж: Check the basis for responding with a link to information already published. Enter the part number of Article 19 and select what such a link must achieve.
strings.Проект А предлагает указать адрес официа: Draft A proposes giving the official publication address, file names and route to the appendices. Draft B declares that sending any links is unlawful and proposes producing certified copies instead of using the existing documents.
strings.Прошу предоставить в электронной форме п: Please provide electronically the adopted decision on the {{caseYear}} budget, with appendices 1 and 2. Neither a certified copy nor paper format is requested.
strings.Размещение информации даёт допустимый сп: Publication provides a permissible way of responding, not grounds to ignore a received request unconditionally.
strings.Сообщить об отсутствии документов, потом: Report that the documents are unavailable because the link changed.
strings.Сопоставить реквизиты, редакцию и оба пр: Compare the identifying details, version and both appendices
strings.Сопоставьте состояние публикации с подго: Compare the publication's current state with the prepared response.
strings.Ссылка позволяет получить именно запроше: The link provides access to the specific published information requested; attachments and accessibility must be checked.
strings.Текст решения о бюджете на {{caseYear}}: The text of the decision on the {{caseYear}} budget and both appendices; electronic access is suitable. I did not order a certified copy.
strings.Техническое изменение адреса не означает: A technical address change does not mean the documents have disappeared; the chosen method of responding must remain usable.
strings.Только общий порядок жалоб по 59-ФЗ: Only the general complaints procedure under 59-ФЗ
strings.Учебная модель органа местного самоуправ: A training model of a local self-government body holding an adopted budget decision. You prepare a response under 8-ФЗ. The simulated publication and documents are fictional; no violation is attributed to a real municipal body.
strings.Часть 3 статьи 19 допускает указание мес: Part 3 of Article 19 allows the place of publication to be indicated. It is necessary to establish that the requested information is actually there.
strings.Это официальный сайт муниципального окру: This is the official website of Nizhegorodsky Municipal District in Moscow. It is not the website of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast and is not identical to the district administration's website.
